data.name: Bussme Energy
data.description: Bussme Energy AB is a Swedish family-owned company founded in 2010 operating district heating plants in southern Sweden (Skåne), with a biochar production side-business via its subsidiary Bussme Biochar AB based in Svedala/Kävlinge. The company divested several district heating plants to Solör Bioenergi in 2020 and 2024 but continues heating and biochar operations, claiming to be one of Europe's largest biochar producers.
